title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 35 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 35)

content.overview: Section 35 provides that an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them, subject to the Act's statutory remedies.
content.glance: Section 35 provides that an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them, subject to the Act's statutory remedies.
content.study:
Statutory rule: Section 35 provides that an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them, subject to the Act's statutory remedies.

Operative conditions: Identify every statutory ground, proviso and procedural consequence before applying the facts.

Connected remedies: Read section 35 with the immediately relevant provisions of the Act, particularly the statutory remedy or enforcement provision that follows from it.
